ov: Freshwater fish closely related to salmon. Most spend their whole lives in lakes and rivers, migrating upstream to spawn in gravel beds of small headwater streams. A few, like the steelhead, go to sea.

why.et: A popular food fish, somewhat bonier than other salmonids.

rg: Rivers and lakes; brown trout prefer strong currents.
df: Aquatic invertebrates and other small animals.

cf.tip: Trout and salmon are close relatives in the same family, with similar migrations; most trout stay in fresh water.

fx: Young trout are called alevin, then parr.
